question:
Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.

Go back to your image __description. __
solution:
The correct answer is "**Definition**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **'Description" means a statement or a piece of writing that tells what something or someone is like**.(विवरण)

 
 
• Example: Your description of the play was hilarious.
 
 
 
• **"Definition" means a statement or explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase**.(परिभाषा)
 
 
• Example: The dictionary provides the definition of the word "synonym".
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "definition" is the synonym of the word "description."

Hence,** the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Deception) means the act of deceiving or misleading someone.(धोखा)
 
• Option 3 (Plan) means a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.(योजना)
 
• Option 4 (Function) means the purpose or role of something.(समारोह)
